ushers.title: Ushers’ training manual
ushers.intro: Capture visitors on the public form and sign into the separate usher portal to record service attendance.
ushers.body:
1. Open the public form

Bookmark Open the public visitor form. You can also find this link on Team Login before signing in. The public form lets you submit information; it does not let you browse the church database.

2. Before capturing a visitor

  1. Explain that the church will use the information for visitor care and follow-up. Confirm the visitor agrees.
  2. Check that another usher has not already entered the same visitor from the same card. Choose one capture method per visitor; do not enter the same card into both the Google Form and this form.
  3. Have the visitor's completed card ready. Only type answers they actually provided. Leave optional unanswered fields blank.

3. Enter the information

  1. Check Service date. It starts with today's Johannesburg date. If capturing an earlier service, change it.
  2. Enter Full name accurately. This is required.
  3. Enter their email and cellphone if provided. Double-check every phone digit; a wrong number prevents follow-up.
  4. Enter the service attended, area, birthday and other supplied answers.
  5. Copy prayer points respectfully. Do not add guesses or personal opinions.
  6. Record the visitor's answer about WhatsApp and membership. Agreement to follow-up does not automatically mean agreement to a WhatsApp group.
  7. Tick the agreement checkbox only after the visitor has agreed.

4. Save and enter the next visitor

  1. Select Submit visitor form once.
  2. Wait while the button says Saving visitor…. Do not close the page.
  3. Look for the success message with the visitor's name and reference.
  4. The visitor fields clear; the service date and service name stay selected for the next entry. Check these before continuing.

If something goes wrong

If there is no success message, do not assume it saved. Keep the form open. If the result is uncertain, ask an admin to check the visitor's name before submitting again. If you entered a wrong number or duplicate, tell the admin the visitor's name and reference; do not submit a second form as a correction.

This form does not save an offline draft. Retain the original visitor card securely until the admin confirms capture, according to church procedure.

End-of-service handover

Tell the admin how many visitor cards were captured and which need checking. Hand urgent prayer or care needs directly to the responsible pastor; submitting the form does not send an emergency alert. Clear the device screen before handing it to someone else.

Practice with the trainer

Explain where the form link is, identify today's service date, and describe the success message. For a live practice submission, first ask the trainer to designate a clearly labelled training record so practice data is not mistaken for a real visitor.

Service attendance portal

  1. Ask the administrator for an usher account and generated password.
  2. Open Usher attendance login.
  3. Select the service date and type. Enter Sunday first and Sunday second separately on the same date.
  4. Count adult men, adult women, teens and children separately. Never count the same person in two categories. Use the church’s agreed age categories.
  5. Give special events a name, enter all four counts, then select Save attendance.
  6. Wait for the success message. If a service already exists, ask an administrator to check it. Do not submit another entry.

Only admins and pastors can view attendance history, compare figures, export reports or correct recorded counts. Tell an administrator the service date, service type and correct figures when a correction is needed.

Usher accounts cannot access visitor profiles, follow-up records, pastoral notes or visitor exports. Visitor capture remains public and does not require login.

Privacy concerns

Tell Leadership immediately if information reaches the wrong person, a device is lost, or you suspect unauthorised access. Stop further sharing and preserve the details of what happened. Do not delete audit records. Refer requests to access, correct or delete personal information to Leadership. Never share visitor screenshots or prayer requests with friends or informal groups.

team.title: Follow-up team training manual
team.intro: Work together on new visitors, assign responsibility clearly, and keep the next action current.
team.body:
Access and help

Open Team Login on your phone or computer. Use your own email and the password supplied by church leadership. There is no public staff signup. For a forgotten password, ask a Super Admin or pastor to generate another one. Never share an account.

Use Sign out when finished, especially on a shared device. Signing in, approximate location, device information, and activity are recorded. An internet connection is required. If a save fails, keep your work open and read the message before trying again.

Respect each visitor

Use contact information only for authorised church care. Follow the visitor's WhatsApp preference. Keep prayer requests confidential. Ordinary follow-up notes are visible to the authorised follow-up team and leaders; they are not private personal notes. Record facts and agreed next steps, without unnecessary sensitive details.

1. Start your session

  1. Sign in. Your starting page is the Follow-Up Board.
  2. Open a person's card to see their profile and prayer points.
  3. New visitors appear for the full authorised follow-up team as soon as the form saves.
  4. Open a profile, choose an active follow-up worker under Assigned to, and save. Use My queue when you want to focus on your own assignments.

2. Prepare and contact

Read the existing notes before calling to avoid repeating a conversation. Check the contact details and prayer requests. Open WhatsApp opens the conversation in WhatsApp; it does not send a message automatically. Follow the visitor's preferences and the church's agreed contact times.

3. Record the outcome

  1. Choose the appropriate Follow-up status.
  2. For a return call, set Next follow-up date. Check your device's local time setting.
  3. Enter a short Update summary and select Save follow-up changes. Wait for confirmation.
  4. For a fuller conversation record, use Notes → Add note. Saving a note is separate from saving follow-up changes.
StatusWhen to use it
PendingNo first contact attempt has been recorded.
ContactedYou reached the visitor and had a conversation.
Not reachableYou tried but could not reach the visitor. Add the attempt and next step.
Follow Up AgainAnother conversation is needed. Set a next follow-up date.
CompletedThe agreed follow-up is finished. Add an outcome note.
Voicemail / Not InterestedUse when accurate. Respect a request not to be contacted.

Some older records show Contacted (legacy). Do not change statuses just to improve the dashboard numbers.

A useful note

“Spoke with visitor. They requested a call on Tuesday afternoon about membership. Follow-up arranged for Tuesday 15:00.” Avoid unverified claims and unnecessary personal information. Notes show the author and time.

4. Escalate and finish

Tell the pastor directly when a visitor needs urgent pastoral attention. Notes alone do not notify someone immediately. Ask a leader to correct profile details or change the assigned person. Before signing out, check that each completed call has its status, note and next step saved.

Real-time updates and troubleshooting

Saved changes become visible to authorised leaders and other authorised viewers while connected. If a record is reassigned, it remains visible to the authorised follow-up team, while My queue moves it to the new owner. If your screen looks stale, check the connection and reload after saving. Do not overwrite another person's work without checking the latest notes.

Practice with the trainer

On a designated training record: open the profile, add a factual note, select Follow Up Again, set a next date, save, then reopen it to verify. Ask the trainer to confirm the change is visible on the leader's screen.

Visitor journey and pastoral care

Open a visitor profile and use Care journey & timeline to record first visits, return visits, calls, agreed next steps, discipleship class starts/completions, membership interest and joining. Enter the actual date, not an assumed date. The timeline combines these events with follow-up notes and assignments.

Use Request pastoral attention to flag a reason and priority. These requests are shared with the assigned worker and leaders. For urgent situations contact the pastor directly; a queue entry is not an emergency notification.

Reports and access

The authorised follow-up team can see incoming visitors and assign them to active follow-up workers. You cannot export reports, view attendance statistics or read restricted pastoral notes. Ask an administrator when an authorised church task needs a report.

Privacy concerns

Tell Leadership immediately if information reaches the wrong person, a device is lost, or you suspect unauthorised access. Stop further sharing and preserve the details of what happened. Do not delete audit records. Refer requests to access, correct or delete personal information to Leadership. Never share visitor screenshots or prayer requests with friends or informal groups.

admin.title: Super Admin training manual
admin.intro: Manage staff access, distribute visitor care, check activity, and keep the system ready for the team.
admin.body:
Access and help

Open Team Login on your phone or computer. Use your own email and the password supplied by church leadership. There is no public staff signup. For a forgotten password, ask a Super Admin or pastor to generate another one. Never share an account.

Use Sign out when finished, especially on a shared device. Signing in, approximate location, device information, and activity are recorded. An internet connection is required. If a save fails, keep your work open and read the message before trying again.

Respect each visitor

Use contact information only for authorised church care. Follow the visitor's WhatsApp preference. Keep prayer requests confidential. Ordinary follow-up notes are visible to the authorised follow-up team and leaders; they are not private personal notes. Record facts and agreed next steps, without unnecessary sensitive details.

1. Create staff access

  1. Open Dashboard → Admin Controls.
  2. Enter the staff member's name and correct email.
  3. Select Operations Admin, Pastor, Follow-up Team, or Usher. Give each person only the access their ministry role needs.
  4. Select Create user. Wait for confirmation and the generated password.
  5. Give the person their login link, email and generated password privately. Do not place passwords in group chats or training manuals.
  6. Ask them to sign in and confirm their correct starting page.

2. Reset or remove access

In Access Overview, find the correct account and choose Generate password when a reset is needed. The previous password is replaced. Give the new password privately. Use Disable access when someone leaves the role. Disabling keeps their historic notes and audit trail.

3. Receive and assign visitors

All authorised follow-up workers see incoming visitors and may assign them to active follow-up workers. Review unassigned and overdue care, then use Visitor care & journey to control automatic assignment availability.

4. Monitor work and logins

Use the dashboard for care priorities, Staff Login History for recorded sign-ins, approximate location/device and estimated active duration, and System Activity for recorded actions. Location is approximate and duration is an estimate.

5. Reports

Download formatted Excel workbooks and use the filter arrows in the headings. Keep exports restricted to authorised recipients. A Super Admin or pastor may approve report access for an Operations Admin from Visitor care & journey.

Visitor journey and pastoral care

Open a visitor profile and use Care journey & timeline to record first visits, return visits, calls, agreed next steps, discipleship class starts/completions, membership interest and joining. Enter the actual date, not an assumed date. The timeline combines these events with follow-up notes and assignments.

Use Request pastoral attention to flag a reason and priority. These requests are shared with the assigned worker and leaders. For urgent situations contact the pastor directly; a queue entry is not an emergency notification.

Leadership tools

Visitor care & journey shows monthly recorded visits, discipleship milestones and contact timing. Missing historical visit dates are not guessed. Mark available follow-up workers, then choose Distribute waiting visitors. Newly captured visitors are automatically assigned while workers are marked available. Unmark workers who are away. Existing assignments can be changed from the person’s profile.

In Pastoral attention queue choose a pastor, update the status, record the response and mark Responded once someone has acted. Restricted pastoral notes are visible only to authorised leaders and are excluded from Excel exports.

Attendance Excel reports

Open Attendance stats, choose the dates and service, then select Download attendance Excel. The workbook includes a readable table with filters and a Report summary sheet. The summary covers the original export selection and does not change when you filter the table in Excel. Counts represent attendances across services, not unique people.

Privacy concerns

Tell Leadership immediately if information reaches the wrong person, a device is lost, or you suspect unauthorised access. Stop further sharing and preserve the details of what happened. Do not delete audit records. Refer requests to access, correct or delete personal information to Leadership. Never share visitor screenshots or prayer requests with friends or informal groups.
